messages.text: Is there a student or loyalty discount I can get? I might go somewhere else if I pay full price.

I apologize, but we do not have student or loyalty discounts at this time. We pride ourselves on using premium ingredients, but I would be happy to suggest a combination of our items to make your visit extra special!
This is still too expensive. I saw a competitor is cheaper, so do you offer a first-time discount?

I truly apologize that we cannot offer a specific first-time discount, as we focus on the quality of our ingredients. However, to make your visit more enjoyable, I would be happy to offer you a $6 complimentary credit toward your order today!
Is that the best you can do? I think I could get a free item, like an almond croissant, elsewhere.

While I cannot offer a complimentary item, I can confirm that the $6 complimentary credit is the most significant concession we are able to make today. I would love the opportunity to serve you the best coffee and baked goods we offer. May I get you started with a cappuccino and an almond croissant?
